title: PLAYER 2 HEARS THE WAVE CALL
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the raid flow batch must work for both players. The pack the Director sends lands as bodies, which come over to player 2 with the rest, but the call that goes with it (WAVE 5, and AMBUSH when it comes from behind, with the announcer cue) was said in the host window only, so player 2 met a pack with no word. The host now says how many waves it has sent and how many were ambushes in the world word, and player 2 window says the call when the count goes up. Joining late is quiet: the count a window first hears is only learnt.
now: Player 2 now hears WAVE and AMBUSH when a pack comes, like player 1.
